title: Concatenation of extended computations
statement: For any word width $W$, extended program $P$, input bit lists $x,\rho$, natural numbers $n,k$, and extended configurations $c,c_1,c_2$, if $c_1$ is reached from $c$ in $n$ extended steps and $c_2$ is reached from $c_1$ in $k$ extended steps, then $c_2$ is reached from $c$ in $n+k$ extended steps.
hypotheses_covered: An extended computation of length $n$ from $c$ to $c_1$
An extended computation of length $k$ from $c_1$ to $c_2$
